layouteditor.title: Edit layout
layouteditor.keywords: layout arrange widgets add remove panel pages
layouteditor.emptyFollowsHover: A click now shows what you see when you point at it, a little bigger. Drag a widget here to choose your own.
layouteditor.selectHint: Click a widget on the notch to change its size, move it or remove it. You can also drag it.
layouteditor.tileHelp: Press Ctrl and an arrow key to move it, or Delete to remove it.
layouteditor.drag.add: Let go to add it here
layouteditor.drag.move: Let go to move it here
layouteditor.drag.page: Let go to move it to {page}
layouteditor.addHint: Drag one onto the notch, or press Add.
layouteditor.changedOutside: Your layout was changed somewhere else, such as on another PC. Reload to see it. Changes you made here will be lost.
layouteditor.status.unsaved: Not saved yet. Press Done to save.
layouteditor.status.removed: Removed. Press Undo to bring it back.
layouteditor.status.rejected: That widget cannot go there or at that size.
layouteditor.status.notSaved: Could not save the layout. Your changes are still here.
